title: cyperus pyramidalis
intro: Cyperus pyramidalis, commonly known as umbrella sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, treating fever, and aiding in digestion. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. These constituents work together to provide relief from various health issues, making Cyperus pyramidalis a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
